meta.title: Free Online Code Formatter - Clean Your Source Code
meta.description: Beautify and format your code instantly - supports HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JSON, XML, SQL, PHP
meta.subtitle: Beautify and format your code instantly

content.p1: Clean up messy code and improve readability with our free online code formatter. Whether you have minified code that needs beautifying or just want to standardize indentation, our tool handles it all instantly in your browser.

multi.title: Multi-Language Support
multi.desc: Supports major programming languages including HTML, CSS, JS, JSON, and more

indent.title: Custom Indentation
indent.desc: Choose between 2 spaces, 4 spaces, or tabs for your preferred style

instant.title: Instant Beautify
instant.desc: Format code instantly without page reloads

privacy.title: Privacy Focused
privacy.desc: Code processing happens in your browser - no data is stored

read.title: Readability
read.desc: Properly indented code is easier to read, understand, and maintain.

debug.title: Debugging
debug.desc: Find errors faster in well-structured code compared to minified strings.

collab.title: Collaboration
collab.desc: Standard code style helps teams work together more efficiently.

faq.a1: Yes! All code formatting is done using JavaScript directly in your browser. Your code is never sent to our servers.
faq.a2: Absolutely! Our beautifier is perfect for un-minifying code to make it readable again.
faq.a3: The formatter focuses on layout and indentation. While it can handle some basic structure issues, it does not fix syntax errors.
faq.q4: Is there a limit on code size?
faq.a4: Since processing is done on your device, the limit depends on your browser's memory. It can easily handle files with thousands of lines.
